value.description: The current value of the input.

count.description: The number of characters in the value.

countText.description: The word count text, e.g. `42 / 250 characters`. `null` without `maxLength` or when the text is turned off.

id.description: The unique identifier of the input.

ids.description: The ids of the parts other elements reference: `input` (the `for` of its label) and `wordCount`.

name.description: The name of the input, as it is submitted with the form. Taken from the closest field.

disabled.description: Whether the input is disabled. Taken from the closest field.

readOnly.description: Whether the input is read-only. Taken from the closest field.

required.description: Whether the input is required. Taken from the closest field.

invalid.description: Whether the input is invalid. Taken from the closest field.

defaultValue.description: The initial value of the input.

maxLength.description: The most characters allowed. It also drives the word count, e.g. `42 / 250 characters`.

pattern.description: A regular expression the value has to match.

inputMode.description: The kind of virtual keyboard to show on devices that have one.

translations.description: The localized texts of the input.

announce.description: Whether the word count is announced to assistive tech. Set to `false` to stay silent.

announceDebounce.description: Milliseconds to debounce word count announcements by, so rapid typing doesn't spam assistive tech on every keystroke. Set to 0 to announce every change immediately.

transform.description: Runs on every native `input` event, before the value is committed. Return the value to write back to the input, e.g. uppercased or digits only. The cursor position is kept. It cannot be set from a Fluid template, only by constructing `Input` in your own entry file.
